intents.title: Unconditional Hand Pan Tool Event Bypass
intents.statement: Ensure Spacebar and Hand tool activate an unconditional pan mode across RadialMap, ConstellationMap, and TopologyMap where children set pointer-events: none, disabling child interception and stopPropagation.

intents.title: Topology Card Layout and Upward Violation Curves
intents.statement: Fix TopologyMap card geometry with left-aligned text, reasonable icon badges, upward red violation routing, and double-click deference to Constellation.

intents.title: Constellation Rule Violations and Line Hitboxes
intents.statement: Correctly attribute constraint violations to nodes and ancestors across dot and slash formats, render red alert badges and links, and add 14px transparent hitboxes for generous line selection.

intents.title: Radial Text Scaling, Normal Icon Proportions, and Consistent Legend Data
intents.statement: Scale down normal domain icons in Radial, scale radial labels against available arc length and zoom level to prevent premature truncation, and synchronize shell violation counts.
